response.sql:
WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    f.rebtotal,
    f.rebrate,
    f.feerate,
    o.ordertune
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) as baseline_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
),
grouped_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    ordertune,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) as avg_relative_gap,
    (SELECT baseline_rebate FROM baseline) as baseline_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  ordertune,
  avg_rebate,
  avg_relative_gap,
  avg_rebate - baseline_rebate as excess_above_baseline
FROM grouped_stats
WHERE avg_rebate > baseline_rebate
ORDER BY excess_above_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: feerate is never zero or NULL; division by feerate in the relative gap calculation is safe
rebtotal, rebrate, and feerate contain no NULL values in the matched fee records; SQL aggregates will compute as expected
